note: The roadmap is built from the official trophy descriptions alone — which story chapters and missions, which collectibles and counts, in what order. No trophy in the official list is confirmed permanently missable from its description — the missables page says so plainly, and flags the six setup-dependent trophies instead.

stages.advice: Play the main missions in order. Every chapter and mission trophy here is unmissable — it pops when the mission or chapter ends. Do not grind side content yet; the story opens the map and the activities the later stages need.
stages.goal: Finish Chapters 1–4, the final mission, and the named story missions.
stages.title: Stage 1 · Play the story

stages.advice: Stranger strands stay available until you finish them, so there is no deadline — but do them now, while you are exploring, instead of leaving 8 strands for the end. The five named contacts are five of the eight the silver needs. Bret's hunt names its own target once his missions do.
stages.goal: All five contact strands, 8 stranger strands in total, and a win over Cal at fishing.
stages.title: Stage 2 · Strangers & contacts

stages.advice: Sweep the map district by district. Areas, meditation spots, WAiNK locations, cards and garages all sit in the world waiting — nothing here is timed. Buy garages as you go so discovered vehicles have somewhere to live, and register 10 of them to Scooter Bros as you find them.
stages.goal: All 52 areas, 18 meditation spots, 100 WAiNK locations, 3 card sets, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations.
stages.title: Stage 3 · See all of Leonida

stages.advice: Now the counted grinds: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, wins at all 14 drone-race locations and in 20 different races, 50 challenges, $250,000 laundered and $100,000 spent. They overlap heavily — stunts feed challenges, races feed challenges — so the totals climb together.
stages.goal: The activity counts and the money totals.
stages.title: Stage 4 · Activities & grinds

stages.advice: Last, the setup trophies. Each one needs a specific moment — a partner beside you, a clean undetected robbery, 5 enemies in one Combat Focus — so set each one up deliberately instead of hoping it happens. Then check the in-game completion counter for the 100% gold, and the platinum pops with it.
stages.goal: The six setup-dependent trophies, the heists, and 100% completion for the platinum.
stages.title: Stage 5 · Heists, heat & platinum
